name: How To Drift 🏁 [NEW RACES]
desc:
🏁 Go drift.

Drift for cash, build your dream car and slide across 7 maps with friends.

🎮 WASD drive · Space handbrake · E/Q shift (Q from 1st = N, again = R) · F in / out · G garage · N maps · V camera · U hide UI · Y record (Replays pass)

🆕 Oct 20:
More races have been added to each map & now some races will rotate in and out each week. Come back to try out new tracks!
Additionally a number of bug fixes were applied. Check the "What's New" in the settings menu for more details!

We read EVERY feedback & suggestion you send in-game and work hard on adding them!
Join the server!

llm.loop: drift cars to earn cash -> buy and tune cars in the garage -> race and drift across 7 maps with friends
llm.objectives: build your dream car and master drifting
llm.instructions: drift for cash, build your car, slide across maps
unique: realistic manual drift handling with replays
llm.thumbnails: realistic cars drifting with tire smoke on mountain roads
llm.complexity_notes: vehicle physics, 7 maps, garage customization, replay system
